title: Can I WIN MORE Dice Chess?
summary: Series of Dice Chess games on a dice-chess website (wood board, three red piece-face dice, ROLL button) vs online humans (pincher / Xyz2168 / AEKB11). dice faces e.g. bishop/knight/knight, pawn/knight/rook
rules: Standard chess pieces and moves on 8x8.
Each turn the player presses ROLL: three dice are rolled, each face shows a piece type (pawn/knight/bishop/rook/queen/king).
Each die lets you make one move with a piece of that type (up to 3 moves per turn; inferred from 3 dice + dicechess-style rules).
There is no check/checkmate; kings can be captured (frame: 'YOU WIN - King captured' in HkeZayq10p8).
